name: ButtonGroupTokens
summary: How a row of buttons is spaced, and how the corners where they meet are shaped.
variantEnumSummary: Whether the buttons stand apart or read as one connected control.

InnerCornerSize.summary: The radius of the corners where two buttons meet.

PressedInnerCornerSize.summary: That radius while a button is pressed.

SelectedInnerCornerPercent.summary: The inner radius of a selected button, as a percentage of its height — 50 makes it a pill again.

IsConnected.summary: Whether the buttons square off where they meet.

sets.name: Standard
sets.summary: Separate buttons in a row; each keeps its own shape.

sets.name: Connected
sets.summary: One control made of segments: the outer corners stay round, the inner ones tighten.
